evidence.source: 田炜, 复旦大学出土文献与古文字研究中心 article reprinted by Sohu
evidence.text: The author reports 叚 in excavated pre-Qin texts and 假 in Qin-period texts. He interprets the Liye writing rule as distinguishing 假 for borrowing/obtaining from 叚 for lending/giving, and proposes adding 人 to distinguish the written form. He notes that Shuowen and Duan Yucai give different accounts and do not explain why 人 signals ‘false.’ This is a scholarly proposal, not settled consensus.
evidence.title: 〖学闻〗田炜：说“叚”“假”

evidence.source: 田炜, 复旦大学出土文献与古文字研究中心 article reprinted by Sohu
evidence.text: The author reads a Liye document dated to Qin Shihuang year 26 as using 叚 for lending and 假 for borrowing; he gives other dated or context-dated Qin examples. He concludes that the graph distinction later became mixed, with such mixing probably arising around early Han. This is the author’s interpretation of textual usage, not an independently inspected manuscript facsimile.
evidence.title: 〖学闻〗田炜：说“叚”“假”

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, 香港中文大學
evidence.field: 叚 record, Shuowen and bronze graphic analysis
evidence.text: The entry cites Shuowen’s gloss for 叚 as ‘borrow.’ Its account analyzes bronze forms as 爪 and 又 with 石 as phonetic, and says the mouth part in 石 is reduced to two strokes. It lists bronze uses read as 嘏 ‘blessing,’ 瑕 ‘fault,’ and 胡/遐 as interrogatives, among others. This is the database’s analysis, not an independently inspected image reading.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫, 香港中文大學
evidence.field: 叚 record, 廣韻 and Middle Chinese categories
evidence.text: For 叚 the entry gives 廣韻 page 308 and fanqie 古疋, with Middle Chinese categories 見母, 假攝, 麻韻, 上聲, 開口二等. This historical reading for 叚 alone does not prove its phonetic behavior in 假.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫

evidence.text: The entry gives 《墨子·經上》 ‘假，今不然也’ as a cited example of 假 meaning false or not so, and supplies separate borrowing and temporary/acting uses from other texts. It gives no manuscript dating or secure first-attestation chronology, so its sense list cannot establish semantic order.
evidence.title: 假 jiǎ、jià、xiá - 汉典

evidence.text: The project says its historical-character graphics are reusable public-domain educational illustrations and requests identifying the specific image page and source; it distinguishes source traditions such as bronze, seal, and Han clerical styles. No specific usable 假 glyph file was verified in this search.

search_audit.query: 假 叚 说文 出土文献 先秦 秦 简 假 字形
search_audit.outcome: Search results inspected; opened the Sohu scholarly article and 汉典 entry. The article discusses Qin manuscript usage and competing analyses.

search_audit.query: 假 character historical forms Wikimedia Commons bronze seal script
search_audit.outcome: Inspected Commons project provenance and rights description and a file page for 假 labeled Liushutong. The latter is a later transcription tradition, not an ancient artifact form. Search did not verify a suitable ancient specimen image.

search_audit.outcome: Inspected the database homepage, unrelated search-index pages, and official user guide. The tool did not expose a matching 假 result or exact direct glyph image URL.

search_audit.outcome: The relevant exact-match result was a Liushutong-style 假 graphic, not a dated artifact specimen. Other results were unrelated characters and not selected.

gaps: No glyph image is proposed: search did not establish a suitable image with both an exact identity and clear reuse provenance. The Commons 假 file found is a Liushutong transcription-style graphic, and the accessible Xiaoxuetang pages did not return the exact 假 record/image.
The query results for Xiaoxuetang did not identify a verified historical form for 假; generic database pages and unrelated records were not used as glyph evidence.

No character-specific official Unihan reading record could be opened, so modern readings are not repeated as externally verified evidence. Local readings cited in the dossier remain local-only metadata.
No direct manuscript facsimile was inspected. Qin-period attestations and the distinction between lending and borrowing are reported through the article’s analysis.

The proposed relationship from borrowing to falsehood remains uncertain: sources cite both senses but do not establish a dated semantic bridge. The competing account treats 人 as a graphic differentiator, while Shuowen analyzes 亻 as semantic and 叚 as phonetic.
A detailed sequence of dated graphic changes for 假 through seal, clerical, and regular scripts was not established from inspected specimens.
The source packet’s Tibetan and Burmese comparisons were not independently researched and are not used here.

limitations.text: No image selected: exact-match and rights searches yielded no appropriate, verifiable ancient 假 glyph specimen. Commons material located for 假 was a later Liushutong transcription graphic, while the Xiaoxuetang search did not expose an exact record image. This limitation is based on inspected search and source pages.
